purchase.alternative.create.description: Wizard to preset values for alternative PO

copy_products.help: If this is checked, the product quantities of the original PO will be copied

origin_po_id.help: The original PO that this alternative PO is being created for.

partner_ids.help: Choose a vendor for alternative PO

acknowledged.help: It indicates that the vendor has acknowledged the receipt of the purchase order.

activity_exception_decoration.help: Type of the exception activity on record.

activity_exception_icon.help: Icon to indicate an exception activity.

activity_state.help:
Status based on activities
Overdue: Due date is already passed
Today: Activity date is today
Planned: Future activities.

alternative_po_ids.help: Other potential purchase orders for purchasing products

company_price_include.help: Default on whether the sales price used on the product and invoices with this Company includes its taxes.

country_code.help:
The ISO country code in two chars. 
You can use this field for quick search.

date_order.help: Depicts the date within which the Quotation should be confirmed and converted into a purchase order.

date_planned.help: Expected delivery date of goods by the vendor based on the latest information

date_promised.help: Date promised by the vendor for at least 1 or more products to be delivered by.

default_location_dest_id_usage.help: Technical field used to display the Drop Ship Address

dest_address_id.help: Put an address if you want to deliver directly from the vendor to the customer. Otherwise, keep empty to deliver to your own company.

effective_date.help: Completion date of the last receipt order.

has_sale_order.string: Technical field for whether the purchase order has associated sale orders

incoterm_id.help: International Commercial Terms are a series of predefined commercial terms used in international transactions.

lock_confirmed_po.help: Purchase Order Modification used when you want to purchase order editable after confirm

locked.help: Locked Purchase Orders cannot be modified.

message_has_error.help: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.

message_has_error_counter.help: Number of messages with delivery error

message_has_sms_error.help: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.

message_needaction.help: If checked, new messages require your attention.

on_time_rate.help: Over the past x days; the number of products received on time divided by the number of ordered products.x is either the System Parameter purchase_stock.on_time_delivery_days or the default 365

origin.help: Reference of the document that generated this purchase order request (e.g. a sales order)

partner_id.help: You can find a vendor by its Name, TIN, Email or Internal Reference.

partner_ref.help: Reference of the sales order or bid sent by the vendor. It's used to do the matching when you receive the products as this reference is usually written on the delivery order sent by your vendor.

picking_type_id.help: This will determine operation type of incoming shipment

purchase_warning_text.help: Internal warning for the partner or the products as set by the user.

tax_country_id.help: Technical field to filter the available taxes depending on the fiscal country and fiscal position.

accrual_move_ids.help: Accrual entries generated for this line, so it isn't accrued again while one is still standing (posted, not yet reversed or cancelled).

date_order.help: Depicts the date within which the Quotation should be confirmed and converted into a purchase order.

date_planned.help: Delivery date expected from vendor. This date respectively defaults to vendor pricelist lead time then today's date.

date_promised.help: Delivery Date promised by the vendor. If the vendor delivers products after this date, their On-Time rate will be negatively impacted.

forecasted_location_id.help: Location used in the computation of the forecast.

is_storable.help: A storable product is a product for which you manage stock.

partner_id.help: You can find a vendor by its Name, TIN, Email or Internal Reference.

price_unit_product_uom.help: The Price of one unit of the product's Unit of Measure

product_no_variant_attribute_value_ids.string: Product attribute values that do not create variants

product_type.help:
Goods are tangible materials and merchandise you provide.
A service is a non-material product you provide.

qty_received_method.help:
According to product configuration, the received quantity can be automatically computed by mechanism:
  - Manual: the quantity is set manually on the line
  - Stock Moves: the quantity comes from confirmed pickings

qty_to_invoice_raw.help: Ordered quantity not invoiced. This may or may not include quantities that won't be invoiced, depending on the product's Control Policy.

selected_seller_id.help: Technical field to get the vendor pricelist used to generate this line
